name: Scholarship for Diploma in Teacher Education (Visually/Physically Impaired)
department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
benefit: Stipend and cost of books/stationery covered.
eligibility_rules: Visually or orthopedically impaired students enrolled in D.T.Ed.
